📉 2. Market Sentiment & Risk Management

🚀 Volatility is Normal: Crypto thrives on price swings — prepare for them.

💼 Diversify: Protect your portfolio with stablecoins or other hedges.

📈 3. Opportunities Amid Uncertainty

💰 Stay Liquid: Cash reserves = power to buy the dip.
